statement_summary: Security and Privacy Lead designated in writing
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; High risks never accepted
Sanctions; device snooping is serious misconduct; good-faith reporting protected
No terms, no customer data; vendor check; vendor list with card data flag
Annual independent evaluation; processor PCI status checked yearly
Five-year retention of security records
Annual policy review; policies available to all staff
Exceptions and new tools or features approved and recorded
Background checks for device handlers; confidentiality agreements for all
Unique accounts; no shared counter or bench logins
Least privilege by SYS-01 role; no technician export rights; restricted passcode field
MFA everywhere, including MSP-held and bench storage admin logins
Same-day leaver checklist, including keypad and Wi-Fi changes
Monthly account reconciliation reviewed by the Owner
Screen lock after 10 minutes; no overnight SYS-01 sessions
MSP and vendor named accounts with MFA; remote tools only with approval
Password standard; no labels; default admin accounts disabled
Back room for staff only; locked cabinets for finished devices, drives, spare terminal
Use shop systems for shop work; access only what the job needs
No customer data in personal accounts, phones, or USB drives
Lock screens; never share passwords or MFA codes
Training at hire and yearly; phishing simulations; terminal tamper training
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed policy acknowledgments
Call back on a number on file before changing bank details
Approved AI tools only
Runbook for customer data exposure; printed binder
Report to the Shop Manager within 1 hour
Incident log for every incident
Preserve evidence before fixing; save camera footage
Breach determination with counsel; record the determination date
Meet legal and contract notice deadlines; contract clocks from suspicion
Insurer hotline first; no payment without approval, counsel, and OFAC check
Vendor incident reports logged; 10-day third-party agent notice
Lessons learned within 30 days
Annual tabletop with the MSP
Three information levels
Inventory of devices, terminals, SaaS, and customer data locations
No account passwords collected; passcodes only in the restricted field, cleared at release
Customer device access standard; transfers on the transfer station only
Card data only in P2PE terminals; weekly terminal inspections
Retention table: 30 days for customer data copies
SP 800-88 Rev. 2 sanitization with verification and a record per device
Approved AI tools list
Monthly review of SYS-01 exports and bench logs
Encryption at rest; immutable backups; quarterly restore tests
